issues.detail: All 75 items have identical Difficulty (Moderate) and DifficultyScore (3). Zero variance across 15 cases spanning 6 blueprint domains is statistically implausible. CAQS v1.0 §6.1 targets 15% Easy, 20% Moderate-Easy, 30% Moderate, 25% Difficult, 10% Very Difficult. Current distribution: 100% Moderate.

All 15 cases have Confidence: 85, indicating Moderate confidence. No case reaches the 90–94 Accept-with-review threshold per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md. Recommend post-migration content audit before certification.

Case-level scenario text follows a uniform template pattern across all 15 cases ('[Company] is preparing for a CMA-style review meeting...'). While structurally consistent, this homogenizes the business realism dimension (CAQS §3.7). Recommendation: vary scenario framing in a future editorial pass.

All 15 cases have ExhibitCount: 0. The case object includes Items arrays only — no Exhibits exist. This is acceptable for a 'short business-case flow' design, but the QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §1.1 states minimum 2 exhibits. This should be either: (a) accepted as an intentional design choice for this migration, or (b) flagged for exhibit enrichment in a future wave.
